children: The Reserve Bank of Australia will likely further its campaign to tame inflation with an announcement of a 25 basis-point interest rate increase at 0430 GMT. The bank is expected to indicate further action is likely, taking the official cash rate to its highest level since 2008 by November. An increase will represent a second phase of the tightening cycle that has been forced on the RBA by the unresolved war in the Middle East. There are domestic forces at work also, but the biggest issue is soaring energy prices and the threat that inflation is again headed higher, not lower. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
